description: Merge non-major updates once CI passes. Only for repos whose default branch requires CI. Renovate merges by itself, not by GitHub's auto-merge: GitHub's waits for the required checks only, so a red check that isn't required would not stop it; Renovate's waits for every check to be green.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch, pin and digest updates merge themselves when checks pass; majors wait for a person.
